note: A QUEUE, NOT A SCHEDULE. Nothing here is published, and nothing in this repo can publish it.

videos.payoff: Sixteen cards land across four boards in a single tap.
videos.caption: Four boards. Sixteen cards. One tap. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: Four boards resolve one after another — four results from one hand.
videos.caption: One hand. Four boards. Four separate results. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: All four boards taken — the app's top celebration tier.
videos.caption: Taking one board is fine. Taking all four is the whole point. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: Two boards each — and the app says TIE GAME, on screen, in its own words.
videos.caption: Two boards each. Nobody wins. A tie is a real result, not an error. Play free in your browser.

videos.hook: This green is four days old
videos.payoff: The playing surface, four days old, measured rather than eyeballed.
videos.caption: We measured this green instead of arguing about it. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: The sign-in entry was never shown to anyone anonymous, because an anonymous player IS a user.
videos.caption: Our sign-in button was invisible to everyone who had not signed in. The check was 'is there a user'. Anonymous players are users. Play free in your browser.

videos.hook: Every invite code we ever issued
videos.payoff: Every invite code ever issued was 8 characters; every screen accepted 6. Zero redemptions, ever.
videos.caption: Every invite code we ever issued was unusable. The database made 8 characters. Every screen accepted 6. Zero redemptions in the history of the product. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: The achievements screen could only ever say 0/36 — server and client never agreed on a field name.
videos.caption: Our achievements screen could only ever say 0 of 36. The server and the app never agreed what to call the field. Play free in your browser.

videos.hook: We have a test that measures contrast
videos.payoff: The contrast test was measuring a screen dimmed to 60% — for weeks.
videos.caption: Our accessibility test measures colour contrast. It was running on a screen dimmed to 60% the whole time. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: A tie told BOTH players they had lost, because the code only knew win and not-win.
videos.caption: When a hand tied, we told both players they lost. The code knew 'win' and 'not win'. A tie is neither. Play free in your browser.
